PFPI

ROUGHRIDERS RUN ROUGHSHOD TO WEEK 11 TITLE, RETAKE PFPI SEASON LEAD OVER LLAMAS & MANIACS

Dick’s Roughriders are back in first place alone for the first time since Week 6 after a 10-3 mark earned Week 11 honors – and a 1-game lead over Mom’s Maniacs and Tati’s Llamas.

It’s presently a three-team race, with fourth-place Christie’s Ferraris and Greg’s Lobos both 5 games back.

In a rarity, there were no Unique Hit opportunities for the week.

PFPI’s 23rd season of the modern era is now 11 weeks in and seven still left in the long and uphill run for the Dad’s Dynamics Cup championship trophy.
